protocol: Inside observer on a USAF rapid decompression training flight. The source gives the actual peak and quick descent.
outcome_window: Symptoms immediately following rapid decompression. Neurological examination was normal at the end of treatment.
note: The author describes one selected 38-year-old inside observer. A presumptive arterial gas embolism diagnosis was recorded. Exposure denominator and longer-term follow-up are unavailable. The original does not establish brain or pulmonary imaging confirmation.
